to: each character in `to` of the `cm` request that is on this server. The sender too, if `to` has its name

fields.name: message
fields.description: The `message` of the request, unchanged: any JSON value. A falsy value (absent, `null`, `0`, `false`, `""`) becomes `""` (node/server.js:5086).

senders.what: The `cm` handler: one `cm` for each name in `to` that is online on this server.
